objective.text: The objective was to use numerical simulation to explore gravity's influence on pyrolysis smoke growth from a fundamental perspective.
objective.quote: The objective of this investigation was to use numerical simulation to explore the influence of gravity on pyrolysis smoke growth from a fundamental perspective.

fuel.text: The formation and growth of dibutyl-phthalate particles was simulated.
fuel.quote: The formation and growth of dibutyl-phthalate (DBP) particles in Earth gravity and microgravity environments was simulated.

measurements.text: Instantaneous scalar fields were used to describe particle accumulation and growth in the wakes.
measurements.quote: Instantaneous scalar fields were used to describe particle accumulation and growth in the buoyant and non-buoyant wakes that form downstream of the hot vapor source.

earth_benefits.text: Models and tools characterizing smoke particles can be used to ascertain how temperature, gravity, and material properties affect produced smoke.
earth_benefits.quote: Models and tools that characterize particles generated as smoke can be used to ascertain how temperature, gravity, and material properties affect the smoke produced.
